run_metadata.methodology_note: Scores are produced by BSIEvaluator, an offline lexical/keyword-based proxy for the seven BIO v1.0 dimensions (regex and keyword matching, not semantic understanding). They are first-pass triage signals, not a validated measurement of analytical quality, until checked against independent human judgement on a representative sample. Do not cite numeric BSI scores as a certified metric without that validation step.
